component: OAuth dynamic callback port and token exchange

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The loopback listener selects a socket port and updates the request redirect. OAuth snapshots that URI into _requestRedirectURI before dispatch and uses the snapshot for token exchange after request cleanup can clear the request object. Preserve this request identity across both steps; the property is separate from the configured provider endpoint. No real provider or native callback was tested.
title: OAuth authorization-code exchange keeps the redirect URI chosen for that request
